profile.name: Roger
profile.diagnosis: High-grade, Grade II mast cell tumor of the right caudal flank, completely excised

sourceNotes.label: Oncology consultation
sourceNotes.summary: Recommended 8 vinblastine injections (4 weekly, then 4 every two weeks), CBC before each treatment, restaging at doses 4 and 8. Estimated complete treatment-course cost approximately $3,500–$4,000; approximately $250 per chemotherapy injection excluding primary-veterinarian bloodwork; restaging approximately $700.

sourceNotes.label: Histopathology
sourceNotes.summary: Mast cell tumor, Grade II (Patnaik) / high grade (Kiupel); mitotic count 8; complete excision; nearest peripheral margin 6 mm and deep margin 5 mm; vascular invasion not observed.

treatments.clinicalSummary: First vinblastine treatment. CBC described as unremarkable. Chemistry showed mildly elevated liver enzymes.
K-State documented decreased energy after treatment #1. Neutrophils were 0.25 K/µL on 8/20; amoxicillin was started.

treatments.doseReason: 10% increase from treatment #2 after counts recovered; treatment delayed one week after 9/3 neutropenia.
treatments.clinicalSummary: K-State recorded manageable nausea after treatment #2 and recovery of counts before treatment #3.

treatments.doseReason: Slight increase after prior treatment was tolerated.
treatments.clinicalSummary: Vinblastine plus restaging. Abdominal ultrasound and liver/spleen cytology found no evidence of mast cell tumor involvement or other cancer.

treatments.doseReason: Continued dose escalation with hematologic recovery.
treatments.clinicalSummary: Clinical note records vinblastine 2.0 mg (2.42 mg/m²). Prednisone decreased to 10 mg daily.
treatments.recordCheck: The 10/2 invoice contains two separate 2 mL vinblastine billing lines. Clinical note states 2.0 mg total; verify with K-State.
